race.description: Carlton Draught Murray Bridge Gold Cup (L)
race.comment: The Balaklava Cup won by SAV ON ICE over this distance 17 days ago is the key form reference. CICALA (8) finished a close fourth in that race as $3.30 favourite, making late ground. Regular rider Rochelle Milnes goes back on - she has been aboard for all of the mare's four wins. Great chance to repay backers. SNOOPY NOW (10) was midfield in the Balaklava Cup then backed up last Saturday and just missed in a BM74 here at this trip. Boasts a fine Murray Bridge record over 1600m so a big run is on the cards. BOOTLEGGER (4) was well in commission at Balaklava but missed the kick and was not competitive thereafter. Needs luck from the wide draw but has the talent to bounce back. BAMYAN BUDDHA (7) raced handy and finished third in the aforementioned Cup at the second run back from a spell. Generally peaks third-up so this is well within reach. Track specialist I CATCHEM FOX (9) wasn't far behind SAV ON ICE when fresh from a spell last time - likely improver.
